records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+9 for standard use or 1+14 for greater control/economy. For 1 litre at 1+9 use 100 ml concentrate plus 900 ml water.
records.reuseInstructions: ILFORD states MULTIGRADE has good keeping properties and can typically be reused; discard when capacity or keeping-life limit is reached.
records.capacityText: One 1 litre bottle at 1+9 processes about 1000 RC 8x10 inch prints or 500 FB 8x10 inch prints.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Full unopened concentrate stored at 5-20 C: 2 years.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Opened concentrate: use within 6 months; keep tightly sealed.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working-strength solution: no more than one working day in an open dish; up to about 24 hours in a tightly capped bottle.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD Black & White Paper Developers / MULTIGRADE Developer

records.preparation: For paper, dilute concentrate 1+9. For supported technical/sheet films ILFORD also documents 1+9 or 1+19 depending on application.
records.reuseInstructions: ILFORD states PQ UNIVERSAL has good keeping properties and can typically be reused; discard when capacity or keeping-life limit is reached.
records.capacityText: One 1 litre bottle at 1+9 processes about 700 RC 8x10 inch prints, 450 FB 8x10 inch prints, or 100 8x10 inch sheet films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Full unopened concentrate stored at 5-20 C: 2 years.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Opened concentrate: use within 6 months; keep tightly sealed.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working-strength solution: no more than one working day in an open dish; up to about 24 hours in a tightly capped bottle.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD Black & White Paper Developers / PQ UNIVERSAL

records.preparation: Standard working dilution is 1+2+100: add Part A and Part B to water immediately before processing.
records.reuseInstructions: BERGGER documentation states the mixed working solution should be used straight away; the separate component solutions are kept unmixed for storage.
records.capacityText: At 1+2+100 the kit makes about 25 litres of working solution. About 1 litre working solution processes two 135-36 films, two 120 films, eight 4x5 sheets or two 8x10 sheets.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Separate Part A and Part B solutions have very long shelf life when not mixed.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Mixed working solution should be used immediately after preparation.
records.sourceTitle: BERGGER PMK product information and PMK processing guidance

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution from Parts A and B plus distilled water. For example, for 250 ml use 10 ml Part A + 5 ml Part B and fill to 250 ml; exact A/B quantities vary by film and format according to the SPUR chart.
records.reuseInstructions: 250-300 ml working solution develops one 135 film. 500-600 ml develops two 135 films or two 120 films, together or sequentially; no time extension is required for the second film if processed within working-solution life.
records.capacityText: 250-300 ml working solution: one 135 film. 500-600 ml: two 135 films or two 120 films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Part A: 3-4 years unopened; Part B: effectively indefinite.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution: about one week in a bottle filled completely to exclude oxygen.

records.preparation: Bellini documents a two-part A/B system. For replenishment, reconstitute 1 litre from 500 ml seasoned tank solution + 250 ml fresh concentrate + 250 ml water for each bath; recommended dilution is 1+1.
records.reuseInstructions: The manufacturer provides a replenishment procedure for seasoned tank solution rather than requiring immediate disposal after each film.
records.sourceTitle: Bellini DUO STEP Developer Replenisher Technical Data Sheet
